The '''W'eston Falls''' were a waterfall on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]]. [[Mora]] and [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]] stayed in a cave behind the falls after escaping an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack.
